headline.zh: 企业级库存系统现代化

scenario.zh: 一家制造企业需要将老旧的库存管理系统升级为现代化云架构,支持实时追踪和AI预测
scenario.en: A manufacturing company needs to modernize its legacy inventory system to cloud architecture with real-time tracking and AI forecasting

instruction.zh: 确定如何处理现有的单体应用架构
instruction.en: Determine how to handle the existing monolithic architecture

output.zh: 团队规模:4人,架构方案包含12个独立服务,使用容器化部署和事件驱动通信
output.en: Team size: 4 people, architecture with 12 independent services using containerized deployment and event-driven messaging

output.zh: 团队规模:3人,保留核心逻辑,优先迁移API层和数据访问层到云原生架构
output.en: Team size: 3 people, preserve core logic, prioritize migrating API and data access layers to cloud-native architecture

instruction.zh: 选择AI增强的核心功能模块
instruction.en: Select core module for AI enhancement

output.zh: 集成时序分析模型,基于历史数据和季节模式自动生成补货建议,减少人工规划工作
output.en: Integrate time-series model analyzing historical data and seasonal patterns to auto-generate reorder suggestions, reducing manual planning

output.zh: 部署实时监控模块,识别库存差异、延迟交付和异常消耗模式,触发即时告警
output.en: Deploy real-time monitoring to identify inventory discrepancies, delayed deliveries, and unusual consumption patterns with instant alerts

instruction.zh: 评估两种数据库迁移路径的技术权衡
instruction.en: Evaluate technical tradeoffs of two database migration paths

output.zh: 迁移速度更快,数据一致性简单,但扩展性受限于单点架构和区域可用性
output.en: Faster migration, simpler consistency, but scalability constrained by single-point architecture and regional availability

output.zh: 支持全球多区域部署和独立扩展,初期配置复杂度较高,需要跨域同步策略
output.en: Supports global multi-region deployment and independent scaling, higher initial complexity, requires cross-domain sync strategy

instruction.zh: 确认现代化项目的最终交付物
instruction.en: Confirm final deliverables of the modernization project

output.zh: 包含系统组件图、API规范、数据流设计和部署拓扑,支持后续开发和运维
output.en: Includes component diagrams, API specs, data flow design, and deployment topology for ongoing development and operations

output.zh: 核心功能已实现并通过测试,演示实时库存追踪和AI预测能力,可投入试点运行
output.en: Core features implemented and tested, demonstrating real-time tracking and AI forecasting, ready for pilot deployment

takeaway.zh: AI驱动的企业软件现代化让小团队能够快速重构复杂系统,实现更高的开发效率和业务价值
takeaway.en: AI-powered enterprise modernization enables small teams to rapidly rebuild complex systems with higher efficiency and business value
